summary: From the architecture review of the wave-24 P0 (2026-09-28). The universal-fallback tail now holds only CLIs with tool use (bridge.HasToolUse), but four other sources can still put ollama-tmux into a lane phase's chain: a profile's cli or cli_fallback, an EVOLVE_* CLI override, an advisor-proposed CLI, and a policy pin. Its launch refusal (exit 10) is a non-trigger, so the walk ends there and the cycle FAILs. None names ollama today (latent).
title: Every dispatch chain drops a CLI without tool use at plan resolution, whatever named it (profile, override, advisor, pin)
